title: Canonical constant pullback unit square for module coefficients
statement:
Variables and instances are those of the attached Lean module.

theorem ordinaryFiniteConstantUnit_square (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (constantSinglePullbackIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f (ModuleCat.of A A)).hom ≫
        (singleFunctorObjUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).hom =
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).leftDerivedFunctor.map
          (singleFunctorObjUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y).hom ≫
        (leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).hom

proof.text: Specialize the canonical constant-complex unit square to the module coefficient category. Its monoidal unit is the module A, so the resulting equality has exactly the displayed coefficients and canonical single-object unit comparisons. The proof is complete; this compilation boundary caches the instance conversion before the ordinary square is assembled.
